title: pm-eng 1:1 prep - Elena & Marcus
content:
Context / goal:
- Prep for my weekly 1:1 with Marcus (eng lead for runtime & dedicated/private infra). Keep it tactical + unblock key items for API/Console/Dedicated/Private.
- Main goals: 1) surface risks that require prioritization; 2) sync on rollouts and timelines; 3) agree owners and due dates for follow-ups.

Agenda (30-40m)
1) Quick check-in (5m)
   - How are you? energy/heads-up for next week.
2) API stability / throttling incidents (8m)
   - Recap: two incidents in last 3 weeks where auto-throttle misfired (REDW-2487).
   - Impact: higher 95p latency for bursty traffic; customer devs noticed retries.
   - Ask Marcus: timeline for the hotfix rollout and whether we should do a conservative rate-limit tweak in prod before full fix.
   - Notes to self: emphasize customer pain (Matomo, Acme pilot).
3) Console rollout progress + telemetry (7m)
   - Feature flags for new route-level tracing (REDW-3051) currently gated. Need QA sign-off and SRE runbook.
   - Ask: can we move to canary for 10% of orgs next Tue? Any outstanding infra blockers?
4) Dedicated capacity & autoscaling (7m)
   - Recent customer reported warm-start latency spikes when scaling from 0 -> high qps. Potential pre-warm options?
   - Discuss appetite for short-term knob: pre-warm pool for premium customers (configurable) vs longer-term scheduler fix.
5) Private deployments onboarding (5m)
   - Pilot with BetaCo next month. Confirm checklist (KMS, audit logs, network test). Link: Private Deployment Runbook.
   - Ask Marcus: who's leading preflight and who will own support during pilot week?
6) Quick wins / action items + next steps (3m)

Key talking points / prompts
- API throttling: propose temporary conservative limit: rate-limit by token/sec per org with 1.2x headroom. Ask Marcus if ops can flip config while fix is merged.
- Console: need a one-sheeter for customer success about the route-level tracing to surface to beta customers; ask Lina to draft.
- Dedicated autoscale: ask for short performance experiment (JIRA ticket) to try pre-warm pool for top-5 customers.
- Private pilot: draft support rota (oncall + escalation) and collect contact list from Sales.

Unresolved questions I want answered
- How long until REDW-2487 is deployed to prod (approx days)?
- Are we comfortable with canary next Tue for console tracing? Who signs off on rollback criteria?
- Can SRE/infra allocate 1 engineer (0.2 FTE) to run the Dedicated pre-warm experiment for 2 weeks?
- Who will be primary on-call during BetaCo pilot week?

Action items (owner / due) - capture live in meeting
- Marcus: confirm deployment window for REDW-2487 and whether ops can push conservative rate-limit change ahead of full fix. Due: 2026-03-05
- Marcus + SRE: create JIRA for Dedicated pre-warm experiment, include metrics to measure (95p latency, cold-start qps). JIRA id placeholder: REDW-???; Due: 2026-03-12
- Elena (me): draft one-pager for CS on console tracing + share with Lina for copy. Due: 2026-03-03
- Lina Patel: prepare QA checklist for console canary (smoke tests + rollback criteria). Due: 2026-03-04
- Marcus: confirm pilot support rota for BetaCo and nominate primary contact. Due: 2026-03-10

Notes / back-of-envelope items
- Customer impact summary: Matomo pilot (reported after 2026-02-17) - 3 retries per session spike; billing unaffected but dev experience bad. Use as example in meeting.
- Risk: if we change rate-limits too aggressively, may break some high-throughput partners. Need to coordinate with partner-eng.

Links to reference artifacts (paste into Slack during meeting)
- REDW-2487: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/REDW-2487 (throttling hotfix)
- REDW-3051: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/REDW-3051 (console tracing rollouts)
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/1123 (rate-limit config change)
- Runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INFR/Private+Deployment+Runbook

Notes-to-self ( informal )
- Keep meeting <40m. Start with status, then one blocker deep dive.
- Be explicit about tie-breakers (if Marcus says no to quick rate-limit, ask for timeline and communication plan).
- Capture owners in Jira during meeting and follow up via Slack if any missing.

Post-meeting follow-up template (send within 2 hours)
- TL;DR of decisions + action items with owners/due dates + links to Jira/PRs. Copy CS and Sales for any customer-facing changes.

Draft message to post-meeting (to paste in Slack):
"Thanks Marcus — quick recap: agreed to (1) ops to flip conservative rate-limit by 2026-03-05 if deploy blocked, (2) SRE to kick off Dedicated pre-warm experiment REDW-xxxx, (3) Elena/Lina to ship CS one-pager and QA checklist. I'll file/assign JIRAs and share follow-up here. If anyone sees an issue with the rollout windows pls DM."
